canonical_title: Nvidia and major asset managers assemble a $500 billion AI infrastructure financing venture
aliases: Nvidia Wall Street AI infrastructure fund
Nvidia Ohio OpenAI data center guarantee
treatment: Treat the $500 billion compute-financing platform, its August financing structure, the Ohio OpenAI project's revised NVIDIA guarantee, the signed SB Energy investment/capacity deal, and the reported OpenAI SB Energy warrant package as covered. Reinclude only for additional binding capital commitments, signed leases, named financed projects, deployment schedules, changes in participants, closed transactions, IPO/regulatory filings, or financing documents with material new terms.
known_facts: Reuters reported that financial firms including Apollo and Blackstone were working with NVIDIA on a roughly $500 billion financing package for AI infrastructure, alongside BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR.

By August 14, Reuters reported that NVIDIA had signed memorandums of understanding with the consortium for compute-financing platforms aimed at raising more than $500 billion in third-party capital, with NVIDIA able to backstop up to $125 billion or 25% of potential deals.
Reuters reported Goldman Sachs is the sole lender in the initiative and is discussing participation with banks, insurers, asset managers and private-credit investors.

For the Ohio OpenAI project developed by SB Energy, the proposed NVIDIA guarantee was reduced from as much as $250 billion to initially less than $120 billion, with NVIDIA expected to backstop only the first phase.

On August 17 Reuters reported a binding deal under which NVIDIA would invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy and secure up to 8 GW of AI computing capacity at the Ohio PORTS-Pike Technology Campus being built for OpenAI.

The Ohio campus has an initial planned capacity of 4.25 GW using NVIDIA GPUs and networking equipment, while SB Energy and SoftBank plan at least 10 GW of new power generation and $4.2 billion of Ohio grid investment.
On August 31 Reuters relayed a Wall Street Journal report based on draft SB Energy IPO documents that OpenAI had been issued warrants worth an estimated $5.5 billion in SB Energy.
The same report said SoftBank Group and OpenAI are planned tenants in three SB Energy data centers.
Reuters could not independently verify the warrant report and OpenAI and SB Energy did not immediately comment.
reinclude_only_if: NVIDIA or consortium members announce additional binding capital commitments or closed financings.
The Ohio OpenAI/SB Energy lease or related capacity agreement is signed, cancelled, resized, or materially restructured.
Specific data-center, power, chip-purchase or financing projects are disclosed.
The size, capital structure, participant list or deployment timeline materially changes.
SB Energy IPO or other regulatory filings confirm or materially revise the warrant package, tenant commitments, valuation, or financing structure.
